memorial.name: Caleb
memorial.epitaph: I… don't think I'm coming back. Lockjaw. 22 days… The journal — keep it. Please keep writing.

memorial.name: Natalie
memorial.epitaph: The wild. 31d. Journal's yours now. The notes hold.

memorial.name: Tiana
memorial.epitaph: Well. A stranger. 3 days. Statistically, someone had to go first. The journal's yours — try to die less dramatically than me.

memorial.name: Abiy
memorial.epitaph: Oh no. Oh no no. The wild — 3 days of me, and if you're reading this, it's yours now! The notes are good, I promise, keep going!

memorial.name: Aki
memorial.epitaph: The arena. 6d. Journal's yours now. The notes hold.

memorial.name: Elkin
memorial.epitaph: The wild. 3d. Journal's yours now. The notes hold.

memorial.name: Nadia
memorial.epitaph: If someone's reading this in my handwriting — I didn't make it back. The wild. 18 days I held it. The notes are good. Keep writing.

memorial.name: Catalina
memorial.epitaph: If someone's reading this in my handwriting — I didn't make it back. The wild. 6 days I held it. The notes are good. Keep writing.

memorial.name: Carlos
memorial.epitaph: The wild. 19d. Journal's yours now. The notes hold.

memorial.name: Benoit
memorial.epitaph: The arena. 1d. Journal's yours now. The notes hold.

memorial.name: Brian
memorial.epitaph: Should this be my final entry: A stranger. 7 days of stewardship. The record passes to my successor. Maintain it.

memorial.name: Yuki
memorial.epitaph: Should this be my final entry: The arena. 4 days of stewardship. The record passes to my successor. Maintain it.

memorial.name: Mara
memorial.epitaph: The wild. 1d. Journal's yours now. The notes hold.

memorial.name: Tashi
memorial.epitaph: If someone's reading this in my handwriting — I didn't make it back. The wild. 2 days I held it. The notes are good. Keep writing.
